heading: National military associations: assistance at national conventions

tree.heading: Authority To Provide Services.—
tree.text: The Secretary of a military department may provide services described in subsection (c) in connection with an annual conference or convention of a national military association.

tree.heading: Conditions for Providing Services.—
tree.text: Services may be provided under this section only if—

children.text: the provision of the services in any case is approved in advance by the Secretary concerned;
the services can be provided in conjunction with training in appropriate military skills; and
the services can be provided within existing funds otherwise available to the Secretary concerned.

tree.heading: Covered Services.—
tree.text: Services that may be provided under this section are—

tree.heading: National Military Associations.—
tree.text: The Secretary of Defense shall designate those organizations which are national military associations for purposes of this section.

tree.heading: Regulations.—
tree.text: The Secretary of Defense shall prescribe regulations to carry out this section.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2000—Pub. L. 106–398 renumbered section 2548 of this title as this section.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Pub. L. 101–189, div. A, title III, § 329(b), Nov. 29, 1989, 103 Stat. 1417, provided that: “Section 2548 [now 2558] of title 10, United States Code, as added by subsection (a), shall take effect on the date of the enactment of this Act [Nov. 29, 1989].”
